title: OpenAPI 3.1 definition validates and includes all live operations, security schemes, required schemas, errors and examples.
evidence: There is no OpenAPI document.

title: AsyncAPI definition validates and matches approved event topic catalog and payload schema hashes.
evidence: There is no AsyncAPI document or event topic catalogue.

title: Backward-compatible additive change passes consumer-driven contract tests.
evidence: No consumer-driven contract tests.

title: Breaking schema change without version bump blocks release.
evidence: Nothing blocks a release on a breaking change.

title: Unsupported API major version returns documented safe response with deprecation guidance.
evidence: Only /api/v1 exists; an unknown version is just not found, with no deprecation guidance.

title: Patient identifiers never appear in public or global API object IDs.
evidence: Public ids are random, never derived from a patient identifier, and webhook and partner messages carry references only. No test scans every id.

title: Cursor pagination cannot leak records when privilege is revoked between pages.
evidence: There are no cursors; lists are capped instead.

title: OpenAPI examples and SDK fixtures contain no real patient data.
evidence: There are no published examples or SDK fixtures to check.

title: Interactive OAuth flow enforces PKCE and exact registered redirect URI.
evidence: No OAuth: partners use signed messages, not an interactive flow.

title: Machine client cannot use missing, expired, wrong-audience or wrong-region token.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a missing, malformed, stale, future or wrong-key credential is refused. There are no audience or region claims.

title: Partner whose read scope exists but lacks relationship/purpose cannot fetch patient resources.
evidence: A partner cannot read patient resources at all, so there is no scope to check.

title: Partner cannot change tenant, patient ID, object property or region to escalate privileges.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: the customer comes from the key, never the body, and extra body fields are held. No test tries to switch tenant, patient or region.

title: Revoked certificate or client credentials block new calls immediately per revocation policy.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a suspended or revoked partner is refused at once. There are no certificates, only secrets.

title: Rotated signing keys validate across only the approved overlap interval.
evidence: test_partner_events.py, test_webhooks.py: a rotated secret ends the old one at once. There is no approved overlap interval.

title: Embedded SDK source and sample apps contain no long-lived production secret.
evidence: There is no SDK or sample app.

title: Cross-border API request is denied without explicit GHE-04/05 transfer authority.
evidence: No cross-border handling.

title: Valid signed webhook is accepted once and issued a receipt reference.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a correctly signed message is accepted once and gets a receipt id.

title: Tampered body is rejected before interpreting sender-provided clinical state.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a changed body fails the signature and nothing in it is read.

title: Expired timestamp, missing nonce or reused nonce with changed digest is rejected.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a stale or future timestamp, a missing delivery id, and a reused id with different content are refused.

title: Duplicate legitimate webhook has at most one domain business effect.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a repeated delivery is stored once. No domain effect exists yet to count.

title: Unverified destination, redirect or private-network URL cannot be registered for callbacks.
evidence: test_webhooks.py: only public https addresses with no credentials or odd ports, a redirect is never followed (a local server answers 302 and the sender stops), and an address on a private network can never be verified or sent to.

title: Timeout/5xx triggers bounded backoff with jitter and preserved delivery ID.
evidence: test_webhooks.py: a server error is retried with growing, jittered waits and the same delivery id, then parked after 8 tries.

title: DLQ entry after retry exhaustion retains owner, policy and evidence and is visible to authorized regional operator.
evidence: test_webhooks.py: a parked delivery stays visible to the clinic administrator and can be sent again. It does not record the owner, policy or evidence.

title: Outbound 2xx transport receipt does not make CLINICAL_REVIEWED or HANDOFF_ACKNOWLEDGED true.
evidence: test_webhooks.py: a webhook delivery never touches a workflow; test_orchestration.py refuses every transport receipt as evidence.

title: FHIR resource failing its pinned profile is quarantined without creating clinical state.
evidence: No FHIR.

title: HL7 v2 ACK updates transport receipt only, not clinical acceptance.
evidence: No HL7.

title: FHIR and source identifier collisions cannot cross-link two patients.
evidence: No FHIR or source identifiers.

title: DICOM UIDs, study identity and version are verified before viewing or forwarding imaging evidence.
evidence: No imaging.

title: Unknown terminology mapping preserves original coding and requires controlled review.
evidence: No terminology mapping.

title: Source amendment/correction supersedes with provenance; original evidence remains traceable.
evidence: No source amendments.

title: Drug/pharmacy and payer transactions cannot be enabled absent approved local license/profile/contract.
evidence: No drug, pharmacy or payer transactions exist to gate.

title: Partner unsupported profile/version halts only affected adapter and triggers visible exception.
evidence: No partner profiles or adapters.

title: Same idempotency key and same body returns same operation without second external action.
evidence: test_partner_events.py, test_orchestration.py: the same key and the same content give the same answer and one stored effect.

title: Same idempotency key and different body produces conflict and no mutation.
evidence: test_partner_events.py, test_orchestration.py: the same key with different content is a conflict and changes nothing.

title: Network failure after outbound POST cannot automatically repeat a non-idempotent clinical order.
evidence: No outbound clinical orders. Webhook deliveries are retried by design because they are notifications.

title: Source query finds previously accepted order, reconciles status without duplicate order.
evidence: No source query or order reconciliation.

title: Out-of-order old event never regresses source version or overrides clinical correction.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a late event cannot move a workflow backwards. There are no source versions or corrections.

title: Crash after local outbox commit delivers eventually without losing request or creating duplicate effects.
evidence: Webhook deliveries are rows in the database, so a crash does not lose them, and the outbox is at-least-once. No test kills the process between commit and send.

title: Disconnect with pending pathway creates assigned human reconciliation task.
evidence: No disconnect handling or reconciliation task.

title: Regional cell failure recovers inbox/outbox and events without unauthorized cross-region copying.
evidence: One region; no cell failure handling.

title: Sandbox exercises synthetic patients only and cannot reach production sources or tokens.
evidence: No sandbox.

title: Mock server produces reproducible signature/timeout/duplicate/mismatch cases.
evidence: test_webhooks.py, test_partner_events.py: the tests use a fake partner that produces signature, timeout, duplicate and mismatch cases repeatably. No mock server is shipped.

title: Partner onboarding blocks client credential issuance before identity/legal/security validation.
evidence: A clinic administrator can issue a credential at once; there is no identity, legal or security validation first.

title: Certification matrix binds partner, region, use case, version and approved contract.
evidence: No certification matrix.

title: Missing or failed clinical hazard test blocks activation for affected feature.
evidence: No hazard tests gate activation.

title: Failed privacy/DPIA/country pack check blocks production enablement.
evidence: No privacy or country-pack check gates enabling a connector.

title: Only signed authorized approvers can progress SANDBOX to CERTIFIED and LIVE.
evidence: No sandbox, certified and live stages, and no signed approvers.

title: Material profile or auth change requires compatibility check and risk-based recertification.
evidence: No recertification on profile or auth changes.

title: Masked audit includes actor, scope, origin, policy version, source evidence and decision outcome.
evidence: Audit rows record who, what, the outcome and the access decision (which carries the rules in force). They do not record origin or source evidence.

title: Global logs, support tickets and metric labels reveal no patient identifiers or clinical data.
evidence: test_metrics.py: metric labels are route patterns only. Logs record error type and place, never messages. Support tickets do not exist.

title: Rate limits protect regional services and preserve separately governed safety workflows.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: each partner has a per-minute budget. There are no regional limits and no separate treatment for safety workflows.

title: Spoofed source or forged source-review attestation is rejected and alerted.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a forged or unknown signature is refused. Nothing alerts.

title: Expired connector certificate produces alert and predictable fail-safe degradation.
evidence: There are no connector certificates.

title: Regional support can inspect attempts without reading unauthorized clinical payload.
evidence: Delivery and message lists show status, counts and fingerprints but not bodies. No test asserts that, and there is no separate regional support role.

title: On connector suspension, in-flight healthcare obligations remain tracked and assigned.
evidence: No in-flight obligations tied to a connector.

title: Offboarding revokes all new transport credentials and retains mandatory evidence.
evidence: test_webhooks.py, test_partner_events.py: revoking is final and keeps the history. There is no offboarding workflow.

title: Patient status distinguishes received / accepted / in progress / clinician reviewed / handoff accepted.
evidence: No patient-facing status of this kind.

title: Clinically consequential event with missing human acknowledgment cannot close pathway.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: a workflow cannot close with an escalation still waiting for a person. 'Human acknowledgment' of a partner event is not modelled.

title: Partner critical-result webhook cannot silently replace independent approved urgent notification channel.
evidence: No critical results or urgent channels.

title: Mismatched or unverified patient/clinical source payload cannot enter the workflow state engine.
evidence: test_partner_events.py: a mismatched or malformed message is held. Nothing connects partner messages to the workflow engine at all, so none can enter it.

title: Employer or payer subscription excludes clinical result details unless explicitly authorized by law and role.
evidence: test_webhooks.py: events are references only and no clinical result detail is ever sent. Nothing checks the receiver's role or type.

title: Local market or capability suspension stops new operations and invokes configured human fallback.
evidence: A suspended pack stops new deadlines only; it does not stop operations or invoke a fallback.

title: Manual reconciliation UI cannot fabricate clinical attestation or erase source ambiguity.
evidence: test_orchestration.py: an administrator cannot enter a review or handoff for the owner. There is no manual reconciliation screen.

title: Final production evidence includes independent partner test proof, security signoff and clinical safety signoff when applicable.
evidence: No independent partner proof or signoffs exist.
